How it works
From question to feedback
in seconds
01

Choose your paper

Select Paper 1 (short answer) or Paper 2 (case study), then pick a question from the list.

02

Write your answer

Type your answer in the text box — just as you would in the real exam. No special format needed.

03

AI marks it instantly

Our AI evaluates your answer against the Cambridge mark scheme with examiner-level accuracy.

04

Improve and retry

Read your detailed feedback, understand what you missed, rewrite your answer, and improve your grade.

Assessment papers
Full coverage of both
IGCSE Business papers
Paper 1

Short Answer

Test your understanding with knowledge-based and application questions. Ideal for building core business concepts.

Format: 80 marks, 1 hour 30 min
Questions: Define, state, explain, calculate, analyse, evaluate
Topics: All 6 Cambridge units
Practice Paper 1
Paper 2

Case Study

Apply business knowledge to real-world scenarios. Practice the higher-order analyse and evaluate questions worth the most marks.

Format: 80 marks, 1 hour 30 min
Questions: Analyse, evaluate & justify
Context: Business case study provided
Practice Paper 2

Which part?
Which part?
Uploading the PDF is recommended for the most accurate reading — but you can paste the text below instead, or upload a photo/screenshot if the case study has a graph or chart, since the AI can read images directly. You can select or add multiple images if the case study spans more than one page. Use BestExamHelp to download the insert — you can also find it in the Past Papers section of this site.
Part E doesn't require application, so a case study context isn't needed here.
Only include the mark scheme for this one question — not the whole paper's mark scheme. If you upload the full mark scheme PDF, trim the extracted text down to just this question afterward, so the AI doesn't mark against the wrong question's points. A photo/screenshot of just the relevant section works well too — you can add multiple images if needed. Find mark schemes in the Past Papers section of this site.
